purpose: Avoid starting new batches during closed-lid sleep after three started DeepSeek High attempts were affected.
rule: Before each new Prime batch, read AppleClamshellState using ioreg; launch only if it is explicitly No (lid open). Otherwise return a host-not-ready condition without model calls.
scope: Operational launch eligibility only; physics, model, effort, prompt, agent/verifier limits and trial counts are unchanged.
does_not_prevent: Closing the lid during an already-started trial can still interrupt that trial.
